name: Genesis402
description: Pay for proof, not promises. x402 payment-gated APIs that return signed, scoped, replayable receipts. In-progress infrastructure: the payment rail is live; public verification, discovery, anchoring, and broader action-gating are being progressively released.

tools.output: deterministic simulation result with a SHA-256 commitment over the final state vector, plus a rail receipt

params.chains: optional array of base | xrpl | stellar

tools.output: live balance read of the operator treasuries, each figure stamped with its source endpoint
readiness record from a curated static table; not a live feed; not investment, legal or tax advice

safety.spendGuidance: Each call costs 0.25 USDC. Cap agent spend per call and per day; the rail refuses underpayment and never quotes a price a payer can set.
safety.replay: Each payment proof redeems exactly once (HTTP 409 on re-presentation).
safety.failure: A failed task releases the payment proof for re-presentation at no extra cost.

truthLabels: Receipts declare how a statement came to be (OBSERVED, ATTESTED, VERIFIED, CONFIRMED, PENDING, REFUSED, PROJECTION), never whether it is right.
limitations: Authorized does not mean universally right. Refused does not mean universally wrong. Each receipt reports an outcome under a declared scope, evidence state, policy version, and time.
